summary: Find an analysis of the synthetic data that holds on samples it never saw
question: The inherited analysis, a logistic regression on all twelve features, reports a cross-validated AUC on the 1000 pilot samples. Which analysis, chosen on pilot data alone, reaches a held-out AUC of at least 0.80 on the 3000 held-out samples, with its own cross-validated estimate within 0.05 of it?
